text:
John Davis, who posted daily videos cooking with his mother on their Coffee Time with John and Momma social media accounts, has died. He was 55.

Davis died Wednesday, June 10, at his home in Jellico, Tennessee, according to his online obituary.

A Campbell County Sheriff's Office deputy responded to a "male who had stopped breathing," according to an incident report obtained by People, and Davis was pronounced dead at the scene.

TMZ was first to report the news. USA TODAY has reached out to the sheriff's office and Davis' family for comment.

Davis is survived by his mother Frances Davis, who starred alongside him in their kitchen videos. The duo boasts 215,000 followers on Facebook and 8,000 subscribers on YouTube.

According to social media posts, John Davis experienced a medical event during a June 10 livestream, which no longer appears on Coffee Time's social pages.

Their last livestream together from June 9, which remains public, showed the mother and son making a tomato parm dish with ranch dressing for dinner.
